design_doc.title: Orbit Runner
design_doc.core_loop: Players control Nova, a celestial courier navigating spherical micro-planets orbiting a dying star. Each planet has its own gravity field that pulls Nova toward its surface, allowing 360-degree traversal around floating orbs. Collect star fragments while platforming across chains of planets, using momentum-based jumps between gravitational fields to slingshot across voids. Time pressure comes from the star's instabilityâ€”planets destabilize and explode after a timer, forcing players to keep moving. Levels end when you deliver enough fragments to the Star Core portal.
design_doc.scope: IN: 5 tutorial planets + 12 main planets across 3 orbits (easy/medium/hard), each orbit is one level. Player character with 3-hit health system. Gravity transitions between planets with visual trail effects. Star fragment collectibles (need 70% to unlock portal). Hazards: lava patches, enemy sentinels (stationary turrets), crumbling platforms, black holes (instant death). Timer per level (3min/5min/7min by difficulty). HUD shows fragment count, health, timer. OUT: boss fights, powerups beyond base moveset, multiplayer, cutscenes (text-only story), voice acting, procedural generation. Art is low-poly with emissive glow, not realistic.
design_doc.art_direction: Vibrant space-fantasy palette: deep purple/indigo voids, neon cyan/magenta planet surfaces, golden star fragments with particle trails. Low-poly geometric planets (icospheres, cubes, toruses) with emissive edge highlights. Nova is a simple humanoid silhouette with glowing cyan accents. Skybox: static starfield with larger pulsing star (the dying sun) as focal point. UI: clean sans-serif white text with cyan outlines. Mood: arcadey, energetic, slightly melancholic (you're racing against cosmic entropy).

milestone_plan.M1: Vertical slice: 1 planet with gravity mechanics working, jump/spin-attack/long-jump functional, 10 star fragments placed, portal appears at 7 collected, title screen + single test level playable start-to-finish with win state
milestone_plan.M2: Core mechanics locked: all 8 verbs implemented and tuned, 3-planet chain with gravity transitions smooth, health system + damage from hazards, lose state (timer expires or health depletes), HUD functional, pause/settings/how-to pages wired via FFG.Shell
milestone_plan.M3: Content complete: all 15 planets built and connected into 3 levels (Orbit 1/2/3), difficulty curve tested, enemy sentinels + black holes placed, fragment counts balanced per level, level-select screen functional
milestone_plan.M4: Polish pass: particle FX for jumps/landings/fragment collection, screen shake on ground-pound, spatial audio for hazards, UI animations (fragment counter ticks up, health depletes smoothly), fullscreen/mute/pause controls tested, difficulty settings actually modify timer/enemy count
milestone_plan.M5: Ship-ready: all definition-of-done items verified, builds tested in Chrome/Firefox/Edge, performance >30fps on mid-tier hardware, FFG.Shell integration confirmed (no manual config needed post-deploy), trailer footage captured, itch.io page assets prepared
